author: kraken____
body:
So, its extremely annoying when your pvping and some guy with a bow just shoots you down? Or when you just come out of your spawn and you get shot. Or when your about to hit someone and they just turn and shot you? Im sure it happened to all of you. Its a simple thing that can make a big difference. Take the Bow out of it and I think it would make a lot of players happy. TDM is my favorite map to play on and its so annoying. Or at least can you 64 arrows out of the shop during that match? Or/And Spawn with 1 arrow and not collect any? 

Please take this into consideration.

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body: Yeah, I agree that the bows can get annoying if you can't seem to dodge them, but that's honestly the fun of Venomous TDM. It really teaches you to watch your surroundings and stay alert. Besides, it makes the whole gameplay of the map fast-paced and exciting. I always get a rush of adrenaline when I get 4 kills in a row and get 3 shots with a bow afterwards. I understand why some people wouldn't like it, but the majority of the playerbase enjoys this feature and thus I don't see it being removed any time soon.
